abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not a supported Birdie device.

error.no_devices_found: No Birdie devices were discovered. You can still add one manually by entering its Bluetooth address.

user.title: Add Birdie device
user.description: Select a discovered Birdie device, or enter the Bluetooth address manually.

error.sample_age_too_short: Maximum sample age must be at least the larger of the poll interval and Bluetooth cooldown, plus the session timeout.
error.whole_seconds: Enter a whole number of seconds.

init.title: Birdie polling
init.description: All times are in seconds. Bluetooth is released after each reading so the Birdie app can connect between polls.

data_description.poll_interval: Time to wait after a successful session before polling again.
data_description.connection_cooldown: Minimum time to leave Bluetooth free between sessions for the Birdie app.
data_description.retry_interval: Time to wait before retrying a failed read.
data_description.session_timeout: Maximum time to spend connecting and reading or changing settings.
data_description.max_sample_age: Cached readings become unavailable after this time without a successful read, allowing other room sensors to take over. The default is 3600 seconds (1 hour).
